The discovery conversation clarifies the situation and tests fit. It does not automatically enrol a visitor in a programme. If there is a fit, the next step is a clear proposed scope covering focus, format, cadence, responsibilities and fees.

## Evidence-informed operating logic

Evidence → Knowledge → Patterns → Frameworks → Assets

Every public asset should identify whether it is grounded in practice, research, a named source or clearly labelled reflection. Client identity and identifiable coaching material are not public content.
